+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+import argparse
+import datetime as _dt
+import os
+import stat
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+def _print_err(message):
+    sys.stderr.write(message + "\n")
+
+
+class Opts:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.long = False
+        self.oneline = False
+        self.tree = False
+        self.recurse = False
+        self.all = False
+        self.almost_all = False
+        self.reverse = False
+        self.sort = "name"
+        self.level = None
+        self.absolute = False
+        self.only_dirs = False
+        self.only_files = False
+        self.dirs_first = False
+        self.dirs_last = False
+        self.classify = False
+        self.header = False
+        self.no_user = False
+        self.no_time = False
+        self.no_permissions = False
+        self.binary = False
+        self.bytes = False
+        self.grid = False
+        self.paths = []
+
+
+SORT_ALIASES = {
+    "name": "name", "Name": "name", "filename": "name", "none": "none",
+    "size": "size", "extension": "ext", "ext": "ext", "date": "modified",
+    "time": "modified", "modified": "modified", "newest": "modified",
+    "oldest": "modified", "created": "created", "inode": "inode", "type": "type",
+}
+
+
+def parse(argv):
+    opts = Opts()
+    i = 0
+    while i < len(argv):
+        arg = argv[i]
+        if arg == "--":
+            opts.paths.extend(argv[i + 1:])
+            break
+        if not arg.startswith("-") or arg == "-":
+            opts.paths.append(arg); i += 1; continue
+        if arg.startswith("--"):
+            name, eq, value = arg[2:].partition("=")
+            def need():
+                nonlocal i, value
+                if not eq:
+                    i += 1
+                    if i >= len(argv):
+                        _print_err(f"Option --{name} needs a value")
+                        raise SystemExit(3)
+                    value = argv[i]
+                return value
+            if name in ("long",): opts.long = True
+            elif name in ("oneline",): opts.oneline = True
+            elif name in ("grid", "across"): opts.grid = True
+            elif name == "tree": opts.tree = True
+            elif name == "recurse": opts.recurse = True
+            elif name == "all": opts.all = True
+            elif name == "almost-all": opts.almost_all = True
+            elif name == "reverse": opts.reverse = True
+            elif name == "sort": opts.sort = SORT_ALIASES.get(need(), need())
+            elif name == "level": opts.level = max(0, int(need()))
+            elif name == "absolute": opts.absolute = (value if eq else "on") != "off"
+            elif name == "only-dirs": opts.only_dirs = True
+            elif name == "only-files": opts.only_files = True
+            elif name == "group-directories-first": opts.dirs_first = True
+            elif name == "group-directories-last": opts.dirs_last = True
+            elif name == "classify": opts.classify = (value if eq else "always") != "never"
+            elif name == "header": opts.header = True
+            elif name == "no-user": opts.no_user = True
+            elif name == "no-time": opts.no_time = True
+            elif name == "no-permissions": opts.no_permissions = True
+            elif name == "binary": opts.binary = True
+            elif name == "bytes": opts.bytes = True
+            elif name in ("color", "colour", "icons", "time-style", "width"):
+                if not eq and i + 1 < len(argv) and not argv[i + 1].startswith("-"):
+                    i += 1
+            elif name in ("help",):
+                print("Usage: eza [options] [files...]"); raise SystemExit(0)
+            elif name in ("version",):
+                print("eza - A modern, maintained replacement for ls"); raise SystemExit(0)
+            else:
+                pass
+            i += 1; continue
+        shorts = arg[1:]
+        j = 0
+        while j < len(shorts):
+            ch = shorts[j]
+            if ch == "l": opts.long = True
+            elif ch == "1": opts.oneline = True
+            elif ch == "G" or ch == "x": opts.grid = True
+            elif ch == "T": opts.tree = True
+            elif ch == "R": opts.recurse = True
+            elif ch == "a": opts.all = True
+            elif ch == "A": opts.almost_all = True
+            elif ch == "r": opts.reverse = True
+            elif ch == "D": opts.only_dirs = True
+            elif ch == "f": opts.only_files = True
+            elif ch == "F": opts.classify = True
+            elif ch == "h": pass
+            elif ch in ("s", "L", "w"):
+                val = shorts[j + 1:]
+                if not val:
+                    i += 1
+                    if i >= len(argv): raise SystemExit(3)
+                    val = argv[i]
+                if ch == "s": opts.sort = SORT_ALIASES.get(val, val)
+                elif ch == "L": opts.level = max(0, int(val))
+                break
+            j += 1
+        i += 1
+    if not opts.paths:
+        opts.paths = ["."]
+    return opts
+
+
+def file_type(p):
+    try:
+        if p.is_symlink(): return "symlink"
+        if p.is_dir(): return "dir"
+        if p.is_file(): return "file"
+    except OSError:
+        pass
+    return "other"
+
+
+def classify(p, opts):
+    if not opts.classify:
+        return ""
+    t = file_type(p)
+    if t == "dir": return "/"
+    try:
+        if os.access(p, os.X_OK) and t == "file": return "*"
+    except OSError:
+        pass
+    return ""
+
+
+def display_name(p, root, opts):
+    s = str(p.resolve() if opts.absolute else p.name)
+    if file_type(p) == "symlink":
+        try:
+            s += " -> " + os.readlink(p)
+        except OSError:
+            pass
+    return s + classify(p, opts)
+
+
+def visible(p, opts):
+    if opts.all or opts.almost_all:
+        return True
+    return not p.name.startswith(".")
+
+
+def entries(path, opts):
+    try:
+        items = [p for p in Path(path).iterdir() if visible(p, opts)]
+    except OSError as e:
+        raise e
+    if opts.only_dirs:
+        items = [p for p in items if p.is_dir()]
+    if opts.only_files:
+        items = [p for p in items if not p.is_dir()]
+    def key(p):
+        st = safe_stat(p)
+        if opts.sort == "none": return 0
+        if opts.sort == "size": return (st.st_size if st else 0, p.name.lower())
+        if opts.sort == "ext": return (p.suffix.lower(), p.name.lower())
+        if opts.sort == "modified": return (st.st_mtime if st else 0, p.name.lower())
+        if opts.sort == "created": return (st.st_ctime if st else 0, p.name.lower())
+        if opts.sort == "inode": return (getattr(st, "st_ino", 0) if st else 0, p.name.lower())
+        if opts.sort == "type": return (0 if p.is_dir() else 1, p.suffix.lower(), p.name.lower())
+        return p.name.lower()
+    if opts.sort != "none":
+        items.sort(key=key, reverse=opts.reverse)
+    if opts.dirs_first:
+        items.sort(key=lambda p: not p.is_dir())
+    if opts.dirs_last:
+        items.sort(key=lambda p: p.is_dir())
+    return items
+
+
+def safe_stat(p):
+    try:
+        return p.lstat()
+    except OSError:
+        return None
+
+
+def perm_string(p, st):
+    mode = st.st_mode
+    lead = "d" if stat.S_ISDIR(mode) else "l" if stat.S_ISLNK(mode) else "-"
+    out = [lead]
+    for who in ((stat.S_IRUSR, stat.S_IWUSR, stat.S_IXUSR), (stat.S_IRGRP, stat.S_IWGRP, stat.S_IXGRP), (stat.S_IROTH, stat.S_IWOTH, stat.S_IXOTH)):
+        out.append("r" if mode & who[0] else "-")
+        out.append("w" if mode & who[1] else "-")
+        out.append("x" if mode & who[2] else "-")
+    return "".join(out)
+
+
+def fmt_size(n, opts):
+    if opts.bytes:
+        return str(n)
+    base = 1024 if opts.binary else 1000
+    units = ["B", "K", "M", "G", "T"]
+    x = float(n); u = 0
+    while x >= base and u < len(units) - 1:
+        x /= base; u += 1
+    if u == 0: return f"{int(x)}B"
+    return f"{x:.1f}{units[u]}" if x < 10 else f"{x:.0f}{units[u]}"
+
+
+def fmt_time(st):
+    d = _dt.datetime.fromtimestamp(st.st_mtime)
+    return d.strftime("%e %b %H:%M").strip()
+
+
+def long_line(p, opts):
+    st = safe_stat(p)
+    if st is None:
+        return display_name(p, None, opts)
+    cols = []
+    if not opts.no_permissions: cols.append(perm_string(p, st))
+    cols.append(fmt_size(st.st_size, opts).rjust(4))
+    if not opts.no_time: cols.append(fmt_time(st).rjust(12))
+    cols.append(display_name(p, None, opts))
+    return " ".join(cols)
+
+
+def print_list(path, opts, show_header=False):
+    p = Path(path)
+    if p.is_dir():
+        items = entries(p, opts)
+    else:
+        items = [p]
+    if show_header:
+        print(str(path) + ":")
+    if opts.long:
+        if opts.header and not opts.no_permissions:
+            print("Permissions Size Modified Name")
+        for item in items:
+            print(long_line(item, opts))
+    elif opts.oneline or opts.grid or True:
+        for item in items:
+            print(display_name(item, p, opts))
+
+
+def print_tree(path, opts):
+    root = Path(path)
+    print(str(root))
+    def rec(dirp, prefix, depth):
+        if opts.level is not None and depth >= opts.level:
+            return
+        kids = entries(dirp, opts)
+        for idx, child in enumerate(kids):
+            last = idx == len(kids) - 1
+            branch = "└── " if last else "├── "
+            print(prefix + branch + display_name(child, dirp, opts))
+            if child.is_dir() and not child.is_symlink():
+                rec(child, prefix + ("    " if last else "│   "), depth + 1)
+    if root.is_dir():
+        rec(root, "", 0)
+
+
+def main(argv):
+    try:
+        opts = parse(argv)
+    except ValueError as e:
+        _print_err(str(e)); return 3
+    status = 0
+    existing = []
+    for raw in opts.paths:
+        p = Path(raw)
+        if not p.exists() and not p.is_symlink():
+            _print_err(f'"{raw}": No such file or directory (os error 2)')
+            status = 2
+        else:
+            existing.append(raw)
+    multi = len(existing) > 1
+    for idx, raw in enumerate(existing):
+        if idx and not opts.tree: print()
+        try:
+            if opts.tree:
+                print_tree(raw, opts)
+            else:
+                print_list(raw, opts, multi)
+        except OSError as e:
+            _print_err(f'"{raw}": {e.strerror} (os error {getattr(e, "winerror", e.errno)})')
+            status = 2
+    return status
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main(sys.argv[1:]))
*** End Patch
